i.norm: Verifies that {@link SequenceReader#close()} succeeds even when the backing reader array is sparsely populated, i.e. it contains both a real reader and {@code null} slots. Closing iterates over every element, so this confirms the {@code null} entries are tolerated without error.
Build a reader array of length 4 with only index 1 populated; the remaining three slots stay null.
close() walks through all four elements; the null slots must not cause a failure.
